ConnectionStrings._Redis_comment: Blank = Redis OFF → SignalR + cache fall back to in-memory (local dev without Docker). Set 'localhost:6379,abortConnect=false,connectTimeout=1000' to re-enable.

Entra._comment: CR-AUTH-001 Increment 2 dev SSO. RedirectUri must be registered VERBATIM on the Entra app registration (Azure → App → Authentication → Web → Redirect URIs). TenantAllowList is the US-AUTH-013 isolation guard, keyed by HRM tenant subdomain — FAIL-CLOSED (empty allow-lists ⇒ nobody can sign in). After your first attempt the rejected tid is logged: copy it into AllowedTenantIds. Set the ClientSecret via user-secrets, never here.

techoneglobal._comment: SSO allow-list for the 'techoneglobal' tenant. sachithra@techoneglobal.org is the pre-provisioned Tenant Owner and is matched by email on SSO (gets TenantOwner, not the JIT DefaultRole). Other @techoneglobal.org staff who sign in are JIT-provisioned as DefaultRole. AllowedTenantIds = your Entra directory (tid); AllowedDomains = your verified email domain.

Encryption._comment: P3-4 field-at-rest encryption. GAP-036: the key USED to be committed here, self-labelled 'safe to commit'. It is not — EncryptedFieldRegistry covers employees.national_id, so anyone running the dev stack against real data was encrypting it under a key published in the repository. The value now lives in gitignored docker.env (see docker.env.example); CI generates a throwaway one per run. AesGcmFieldEncryptor FAIL-FASTS when no usable key is configured, so a blank value here means the app tells you to configure it rather than silently storing plaintext.
